note: Heavily vendor-unfavorable contract — exercises red/critical paths across most rules, plus two rules that should not fire (change-order and insurance are absent from the source text entirely, which itself should surface as missing-clause findings rather than being silently skipped).

expectedFindings.why: Cap tied to a single invoice — unreasonably low.
One-sided, unscoped 'any and all claims of any kind' indemnification favoring Vendor.
Assigns Vendor's pre-existing tools/frameworks to Client — blocks Vendor reuse across engagements.
Net 75 and payment contingent on vague 'Client's satisfaction'.
No termination-for-convenience right for either party.
Vendor gets immediate termination on payment default with no cure period; asymmetric with Client's cure-required breach right.
No survival clause — obligation appears limited to the term of the SOW.
Exclusive arbitration administered and arbitrator-selected by Vendor, in an unfavorable jurisdiction.
No change order process defined at all.
Deemed accepted immediately upon delivery with no review window or standard.
No insurance requirement despite a data migration engagement implying access to Client data.
